title: Bamboo Growth
script: You can watch bamboo rise It grows nearly a meter between sunrise and sunset Bamboo achieves its speed by pumping water under high pressure into thousands of pre-formed cells What if a plant could outpace you Bamboo isn't a tree at all, it's a grass, and it's the fastest growing plant on the planet You can hear it grow, with distinct popping and creaking sounds as it expands
